## possible_merge

### KEPT — 3
- **Preregistered ≈ Pre-registered**
  why: Preregistered and Pre-registered name the identical quality of lodging an analysis plan in advance, differing only in spelling.
  papers: W1976120249, W2796350793
- **Declared ≈ Disclosed**
  why: Stating one's conflicts of interest is just a species of disclosing them, so 'Declared' cannot be pulled apart from 'Disclosed' — any declaration of interests is itself a disclosure.
  papers: W2890274243, W4212784858
- **Replicated ≈ Replicable**
  why: Anything actually replicated is by definition replicable, so the two cannot be pulled apart in both directions — Replicated is the achieved case of the same quality Replicable already names.
  papers: W2796350793, W1903435498
